Memorandum
Anleigh, North Carolina 27602
Date: 10 April 1972
TO: Mr. Randolph Hendricks
FROM: Fred F. Harbin
SUBJECT: Draft Environmental Statement, Proposed Endangered Species
Conservation Act of 1972, U.S. Department of the Interior
The subject environmental statement received with your memorandum of 7 April 1972 has been reviewed. The proposed legislation does not impact upon the responsibilities of this department.
